cut_weight_ladder.reading: total weight zero with unit first moment is not a positive measure and not a signed sum of point masses of bounded weight; no positive-norm intermediate-state resolution exists for it
cut_weight_ladder.relation: W_n(m1,m2) = (m1^n - m2^n)/(m1 - m2) = h_{n-1}(m1,m2); W_0 = 0, W_1 = 1; at m1 = m2 = m, W_n -> n*m^(n-1), so W[f] -> f'(m), i.e. the weight is -delta'(s-m)
